summary: Spawned in the Backrooms is a multiplayer survival RPG across the Backrooms, Bonus mall, The Hub and authored destinations. Durable character progression lives in player.state while run/story state is mode-separated; shared scripts and data registries support gameplay and appearance, and place scenes plus sims compose local spaces. Creator tools include BodyWorks fitting, Advanced Transform, character posing and the Spawn 3D Modeling Studio.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze, routes and anomalies; cells hold authored maze pieces and controllers, with sim-local environmental beats and dressing.

places/bonus + places/testlab (3D) - vaporwave mall with shops, homes, atlas Teleport Station, fitting stand and interactive arcade/court props; Bonus includes a slim kemono preview and local atmosphere/set dressing.
places/thehub (3D) - tunnel crossroads, keyed destinations and Camp Amber crews; sim builds tunnels/doors and staffs camps.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo/ephemeral) - character creation/waking and staged tutorial office route; scenes and sims own local beats.
places/level1, level1c, level2, level21, level4, level26 (3D) - camps, procedural halls, pipe halls, Locked storage and authored levels with place-specific sims/signage.
places/level9, level10, level11, level61, level70 (3D) - Cave System/9th Road, Suburbs, farm, city/Base Beta/strip mall/clinic, Snackrooms checkpoint and Froidetown.
places/level169 + places/level132 + places/level178 (3D) - desert/Field Office 7, Duchy of Morigont/Lumiria and barter, and Kyoto terrain/house/residents/arrival quest.
Other numbered and side places (3D) - authored cells and local sims define distinct levels and special rooms; configs identify terrain and lighting exceptions.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer/player entry, camera and ordered behaviors/actions; fall-guard precedes movement and radio, barter and phone attach as player behaviors.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local configuration, placements and generation/tick behavior; sims also run environmental and sign/surface passes.

places/level169/config.yaml + scripts/terrain169.js; places/level132/config.yaml + scripts/terrain132.js; places/level178/config.yaml + scripts/terrain178.js - seeded terrain generators and place terrain marks.
places/level169/sim.js + Level 169 helpers; places/level132/sim.js + l132 helpers - local setpieces, schedules, routes, quests/barter and population orchestration.
places/level178/sim.js + x0z0.scene - Kyoto house, residents, arrival quest, finds, containers and breakable sweep.
places/level1/sim.js + scripts/level1-geo.js + scripts/lib/wallgrid.js - Level 1.1 procedural hall geometry and lamp fixtures; wallgrid supplies corridor topology.
mods/modeling-studio/mod.json + god.js/player.js + lib/panel.js - Studio tab and M-key UI; ask, gallery, preview, sharing and library actions are handled by attached behaviors.
mods/advanced-transform + mods/held-gizmo + mods/bodyworks/tools/bw.py and bwlib/t1.py - transform/posing tools and garment fitting cages/GLB export.
shared: scripts/lib/places.js - canonical place names/labels/HUD titles and valid atlas destinations; consumed by feed, quests and scripts/ui.js.
scripts/lib/grid-path.js - configurable 4-neighbor grid BFS/cache/cell selection shared by Level 0, 1, 2, 2.1, 3, Boiler and 6 adapters.
scripts/lib/critter-model.js + scripts/lib/cat-wardrobe.js - common appearance/body/wardrobe builders for player and NPCs; includes cute and slim cat body variants.
scripts/lib/hub.js + scripts/lib/thehub.js + scripts/lib/hubkeys.js - Bonus solo/multiplayer routing, home/atlas eligibility and Hub tunnel/door key registry.
scripts/lib/mp-guard.js - multiplayer-room detection and nonlethal NPC-down rule; scripts/player.js and scripts/meg-agent.js invoke spared().
scripts/lib/prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data - shared usable-prop/container migration and geometry specs; scripts/interact.js dispatches.
scripts/lib/retexture.js + scripts/lib/sign-tex.js - reusable surface dressing and marker-to-image sign faces; place sims supply per-place tables and completion stamps.
scripts/lighting.js - shared GGX/Lambert lit-surface shader; wet-mask gloss and grazing environment reflections, plus ambient specular to keep indoor metals from going black.
notableExports: scripts/lib/grid-path.js - DIRS, createGridPather; places/level10/sim.js and places/level21/sim.js - cadence, tick.
scripts/lib/ambush-smiler.js - stepAmbushSmiler; l34-smiler.js and l9-smiler.js - configured update handlers.
scripts/lib/companion.js - PERKS, perkOf, isMine, followersOf, loyaltyScale, whyNot, recruit/adopt/dismiss/order, weapon handoff, tick, bring; carry.js - carryAcross.
scripts/lib/ui-kit.js - esc, uiPrefsOf/Attrs, escKeyHandler, emptyState, classifyNotice/noticeToast; scripts/lib/save.js - SAVE_V, canSaveHere, wakePlace, migrate.
scripts/lib/quests.js - journal/advancement/reward helpers; scripts/lib/containment.js - pen/door operations; scripts/lib/run-opts.js - run/mode helpers and keys.

scripts/lib/cat-wardrobe.js - CAT_CUTE, CAT_SLIM, CAT_SLIM_FUR, bodyGlb, catModel, catChildren, skinParams and catMorph; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - STYLE_V (sw215), furrySpec, restyle and appearance builders.

mods/modeling-studio/god.js and player.js - onInput; player.js also exports onBugMailed/onShareMailed; mods/modeling-studio/lib/library.js - LIBRARY; scripts/lighting.js - lighting; scripts/mat-catskin.js - material, lighting.
ownership: scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/save.js - durable character player.state: progression/XP, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo, needs, combat, access, appearance/look, currency and gear shared across Solo/Multiplayer.
scripts/lib/stats.js - derived attributes, skills and combat/carry stats; scripts/stats-ui.js formats; scripts/lib/progression.js migrates progression.
scripts/lib/modifiers.js - book bonuses/read flags/effects; scripts/lib/clothes.js - worn gear/passives; scripts/lib/manuals.js + scripts/player.js - learned recipe IDs.
scripts/lib/run-opts.js + scripts/main-menu.js - mode/run picks; run/quest/story/resume keys swap per mode through SQL slots 91/92 while character and gear remain player.state.
scripts/db.js + scripts/main-menu.js - named save-slot snapshots and hidden Solo/Multiplayer mode snapshots; live character state remains player.state.

scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/lib/tut0-cut.js + scripts/lib/tutorial.js - tutorial beat/cut and Field Guide state/preferences; scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - trail clue flags and legacy dinaQ continuation.
scripts/lib/hub.js noteAtlas, called by scripts/player.js on arrival - player.state.atlas first-seen dates/visit counts; place sims own local texV/signTexV completion stamps.

mods/modeling-studio/player.js + god.js - world.state.m3d gallery, pending asks, shares and library snapshot; scripts/critter.js applies player/NPC look fields to rebuilt body and session animation state.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered locomotion/player/foe, swim/climb/crawl, interaction, combat, inventory, social, hub, camera, quest, CCTV, radio, barter and phone behaviors; scripts/interact.js dispatches focused interactions.
scripts/fall-guard.js holds velocity across place changes for ground streaming; grounded positions refresh session fgSafe, and out-of-bounds restores it or leaves for spawn.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera and aimPt/aimPitch → ballistics/weaponAim; player.js builds local first-person viewmodel and avatar setup.
scripts/player.js wake → scripts/lib/save.js migration/log/wakePlace; valid savePlace crosses to saved place and savePos restores coordinates; player update calls clockHeal on arrival.
scripts/main-menu-ui.js renders Continue/Start, Solo/Multiplayer and expedition/save/settings/controls links; title/pause actions → scripts/main-menu.js, which routes start and run picks.
scripts/lib/run-opts.js mpRoom(party/user) → scripts/lib/hub.js toSolo → party room mp-<party> (or user room); player wake avoids resuming a Multiplayer save in a solo room.

scripts/lib/mp-guard.js multiRoom → scripts/player.js damage and scripts/meg-agent.js death handling → ordinary NPCs restored at 30% HP, stunned and shown DOWN; shootable/born-hostile/killable NPCs still die.
scripts/routing.js requested room → scripts/lib/hub.js Bonus solo-room selection; threshold handlers call carryAcross for held props/followers; Bonus/world/room links are excluded.

scripts/player.js zone resolver → player.state.zone; scripts/lib/places.js → feed, quest labels and scripts/ui.js HUD titles/markers/compass; place arrival → hub.noteAtlas writes player.state.atlas for the Bonus Teleport Station.
Dina diary/records/Hub lead interactions → scripts/lib/dina-quest.js learn/questVoice → player.state.trail tracker and voiced dialogue; story-off runs and Multiplayer bypass the purser.

Bonus usable props → scripts/interact.js press dispatch → scripts/bonus-prop.js reads propKind, per-object session cooldown and player position/yaw; emits sound/flash/light/FX and animated physical props/items rather than text notices.

Salon/player look.slim → scripts/critter.js rebuild parameters → scripts/lib/critter-model.js and cat-wardrobe.js select CAT_SLIM; skinParams + scripts/mat-catskin.js paint its outfit and STYLE_V tracks restyles.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild; dining_set composes table and fitted chairs.
scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml + scripts/player.js + ballistics.js + knock.js + loot.js - weapon variants share combat and rarity/level gates; weights and upgrade rolls vary by level.

scripts/door-geo.js + door-swing.js + prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametric doors/storage, legacy migration and paired leaves; thresholds/sign boards share geometry.
scripts/crawl.js + scripts/player.js + humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - global crawl/crouch and gait; held crouch initiates crawl and tight spaces trigger automatic crawl.
scripts/lib/l169-road.js + l169-road-geo.js + l169-travel.js + l169-door.js - checkpoint structures vary by site and geometry kind; streamed props include route boards and animated doors.

places/level132/sim.js + l132-{stalls,shops,land,people,duke,quests,barter}.js + barter-deal.js - staged town and keeper trades use eight goods categories; first gift then balanced currency-free barter.

scripts/lib/cat-wardrobe.js + scripts/lib/critter-model.js + scripts/critter.js + scripts/mat-catskin.js - cat looks share body, rig, skin shader and morph builders; cute uses shape keys, slim selects a distinct Tripo body with painted outfit and skips incompatible cat flair clips.

scripts/lib/retexture.js + scripts/lib/sign-tex.js + place sims - reusable bare-box/cylinder dressing and marker-to-image sign faces; Level 8 and Level 2.1 supply bespoke face tables and completion versions.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists; Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js + scripts/debug-pad.js - debug-room pads after places/debug removal; no current references found.
scripts/lib/data/l178-skins.json - slot-to-texture skin table has no current consumer; x0z0.scene carries material overrides inline.
migrationNotes: Solo and Multiplayer share one character but not run/story state: scripts/lib/run-opts.js isStoryKey defines the swapped key family; MODE_SLOT 91/92 are separate SQL snapshots and hidden from ordinary Save Manager slots.
Multiplayer room ID is mp- plus sanitized party ID (or user ID); hub.js selects it only when leaving Bonus in multiplayer. Continue must not wake a multiplayer save into a solo room.

Tutorial finale cut ends at tut0-cut.js LEN.final = 14 s; THE WAY BACK / SOMEWHERE WET card is held over black and the crossing, then fades on Level 1 landing; retain ui.js lazy-load and main-menu.js t0lift stamp coupling.

The Hub run frame/coordinates and OPEN/KEYED/SEALED door mapping are centralized in scripts/lib/thehub.js; preserve IDs and destinations together. t5-a2 is OPEN to Level 178; l178-to-hub pairs with sim-created hub-from-l178.

Level 169 uses x/z, north = -z and 1:10 map scale; Level 1.1 hall distance is +X (0–620 m), north at -Z. retextureOnce waits about 8 s with a player and stamps texV; texSigns preserves sign geometry and stamps signTexV.

CAT_SLIM uses a Tripo Mixamo rig and a single fur slot (front +z); it has no cat shape keys/ear-tail-lid bones. Outfit is shader-painted from body.slim landmarks in metres, not wardrobe child GLBs; keep slim flair reset and CAT_SLIM registered as a non-stale body.
